scientific_integrity: The previous exact characteristic function and moment recurrence are credited; novelty is restricted to the all-order matched-Gaussian crossing classification and the sharp singular asymptotic including its logarithmic correction. Publication priority not independently confirmed.
scientific_limitations: One-dimensional, zero-translational-noise trapped run-and-tumble process; fixed positive run-exit rate; exact stationary moments; no finite-sample or cross-rate uniformity. Raw moment formula was published previously.
title: A sharp Gaussian moment-crossover hierarchy for a trapped finite-tumble particle
